description: Example Roo Code configuration demonstrating .roorules conventions, custom modes, API profiles, and MCP server setup
roorules_content:
# Project Coding Conventions

## Language & Framework
- Use TypeScript strict mode for all new code
- Follow React functional component patterns with hooks
- Use Zod for runtime validation of external data

## Code Style
- Prefer named exports over default exports
- Maximum function length: 50 lines
- Use descriptive variable names; avoid abbreviations
- Document all public APIs with JSDoc

## Architecture
- Follow feature-based folder structure under src/features/
- Separate business logic from UI components
- Use React Query for all server state management
- Never fetch data directly in components

## Testing
- Write unit tests for all utility functions
- Write integration tests for API interactions
- Minimum 80% code coverage for new features

customModes.name: API Designer
customModes.roleDefinition: You are an expert API designer focused on creating clean, RESTful APIs. You follow OpenAPI 3.1 specifications and enforce consistent naming conventions, versioning strategies, and error handling patterns.
customModes.customInstructions: Always generate OpenAPI specs for any REST endpoints you design. Use kebab-case for paths, camelCase for JSON fields, and Title Case for summaries.
